cases.title: 暴雨古寺黑鸦寒霜的巅峰对决
cases.imageAlt: 暴雨古寺黑鸦寒霜的巅峰对决
cases.prompt:
英文提示词:
Overall Style Prompt: Chinese Wuxia fantasy style, cinematic quality, motion blur, abandoned ancient temple in heavy rain, gloomy sky, lightning occasionally illuminating raindrops and broken eaves, the image is full of power and speed. • Scene 1 (0-3 seconds): Dark Raven drags his sword, Azure Frost descends • Visuals: Rain pours down. Dark Raven wears heavy black armor emanating an ominous purple aura, dragging a massive chained dark iron greatsword with one hand. The blade scrapes the stone ground, creating dazzling sparks and ripples. His eyes are sinister as he looks ahead. Immediately after, Azure Frost lightly descends from the broken eaves of the ancient temple like a falling leaf. Her white and cyan tight-fitting outfit is sharp, her high ponytail flies, and the blue longsword in her hand is drawn with a 'zheng' sound, its cold aura pushing back the surrounding rain curtain. The two face off in the rain. • Cinematography: Extreme low-angle follow shot tracking the greatsword's path, then the camera quickly pulls back to show the full view of the confrontation in the rainy courtyard—one black and heavy, the other cyan and light. • Dialogue/Sound Effects: Dark Raven (low and hoarse): "You are beyond redemption." • Sound Effects: Heavy metal scraping, torrential rain, wind. • Scene 2 (3-6 seconds): Greatsword sweeps, light sword strikes like a flash • Visuals: Dark Raven suddenly exerts force, swinging the greatsword with both arms. A crescent-shaped black sword energy tears through the rain curtain and sweeps out. Raindrops evaporate in its path, and the stone ground is plowed open. Azure Frost's eyes narrow. Tapping the water surface with her toe, her body shoots up like a kite, executing a nimble side flip in the air, narrowly avoiding the sword energy. At the same time, using the momentum of her descent, the cold light of her sword tip condenses, striking straight at Dark Raven's throat like a meteor. • Cinematography: Fast-paced cuts. First, a side follow shot (Dolly Shot) captures the black sword energy slicing countless raindrops in slow motion, then switches to a high-angle view, showing the graceful trajectory of Azure Frost's aerial evasion and counterattack. • Sound Effects: Heavy whistling of the greatsword cutting the air, 'chichi' sound of sword energy evaporating, sound of clothes tearing the wind. • Scene 3 (6-9 seconds): Mid-air clash, sparks fly • Visuals: Dark Raven swings his greatsword back, colliding precisely with Azure Frost's descending longsword! "Clang—!" The immense power of the greatsword fiercely clashes with the nimble cold aura of the longsword, erupting in dazzling blue-white sparks and a shockwave that pushes away all the surrounding rain. Dark Raven presses down with his strength advantage, while Azure Frost uses her light footwork, tapping the greatsword with her toe, using the force to backflip and resolve the immense pressure. • Cinematography: Orbiting shot (Bullet Time). The camera centers on the point of weapon collision, rotating 360 degrees rapidly, finally freezing on a close-up of the moment of maximum sparks and the two forces counteracting. • Dialogue/Sound Effects: Azure Frost (cold and firm): "Evil will not prevail!" • Sound Effects: Huge metal collision roar, humming sound of power confrontation. • Scene 4 (9-12 seconds): Azure shadows continuous, black wall defends • Visuals: The moment she lands, Azure Frost launches an attack. Her figure turns into a cyan afterimage, her longsword stabs rapidly, instantly transforming into several fierce cyan sword lights attacking Dark Raven from different angles. The cold aura of the sword tips leaves streaks of frost in the air. Dark Raven lets out a low roar, swinging the heavy greatsword into an impenetrable barrier, forming a purple-black sword energy shield. Amidst the dense 'ding-dang' sounds, the cyan sword lights are all blocked, but the powerful impact still forces Dark Raven to retreat three steps, each step crushing the stone bricks beneath his feet. • Cinematography: One-shot handheld follow shot (Shaky Cam). The camera closely follows Azure Frost's attack trajectory, with slight shaking accompanying each stab, then quickly pans to Dark Raven's defense and retreat, creating a strong sense of immersion. • Sound Effects: Dense, crisp sound of sword tips hitting the barrier, sound of stone bricks cracking, heavy footsteps and panting. • Scene 5 (12-15 seconds): Ultimate collision, swallowing the universe • Visuals: Dark Raven is enraged, injecting all his purple energy into the greatsword, plunging it into the ground! Boom! A thick purple-black light column shoots up into the sky, stirring the clouds above. Azure Frost shows no fear, pouring all her cold energy into her sword. Man and sword become one, transforming into a massive, pure cyan stream of light, descending like a comet, striking straight at the center of the light column. The two collide with a roar! Time seems to stand still, followed by an explosive, blinding white light and a circular airwave that sweeps away all the rain, debris, and dead leaves in the entire courtyard. • Cinematography: Rapid close-up zoom out. First, quick cuts between close-ups of Dark Raven's cold eyes and Azure Frost's determined eyes, then the camera rapidly pulls up and back like a rocket (Crane Up), turning into a distant overhead view, showing the shocking full scene of the expanding white light and the airwave sweeping across the ruins of the ancient temple. The image freezes at the peak of the white light. • Dialogue/Sound Effects: (Before collision) Dark Raven's roar and Azure Frost's clear shout intertwine. • Sound Effects: Humming sound of energy convergence, earth-shattering explosion, followed by all sounds fading, leaving only the receding echo of the rain.

整体风格提示： 中国武侠玄幻风格，电影质感，动态模糊，暴雨中的废弃古寺，阴郁的天空，闪电不时照亮雨滴和残破的飞檐，画面充满力量与速度感。 • 镜头1 (0-3秒)：暗鸦拖剑，青霜降临 • 画面：暴雨如注。暗鸦身披散发不祥紫气的黑色重铠，单手拖着一把缠绕锁链的玄铁巨剑，剑刃在石板地上划出刺目的火星与波纹。他眼神阴鸷，看向前方。紧接着，青霜从古寺残破的屋檐上如一片落叶般轻盈飘落，白青相间的劲装飒爽，高马尾飞扬，手中青色长剑“锃”然出鞘，寒气逼开周身雨幕。两人在雨中对峙。 • 运镜：极低角度跟拍巨剑划地的轨迹，随后镜头快速拉远，展现暴雨庭院中一黑一青、一沉重一轻灵的对峙全景。 • 对话/音效：暗鸦（低沉沙哑）：“执迷不悟。” • 音效：沉重的金属摩擦声、滂沱雨声、风声。 • 镜头2 (3-6秒)：重剑横扫，轻剑惊鸿 • 画面：暗鸦猛然发力，双臂挥动巨剑，一道半月形的黑色剑气撕裂雨幕横扫而出，所过之处雨滴蒸发，地面石板被犁开。青霜眼神一凝，脚尖轻点水面，身形如鹞子般冲天而起，在空中一个灵巧的侧翻，惊险地避开剑气。同时，她借下坠之势，剑尖寒光凝聚，如流星般直刺暗鸦咽喉。 • 运镜：快节奏切镜。先是一个侧面跟拍（Dolly Shot）捕捉黑色剑气切碎无数雨滴的慢动作瞬间，旋即切换至仰拍视角，展现青霜空中闪避与反击的优美轨迹。 • 音效：巨剑破空的沉重呼啸、剑气蒸发的“嗤嗤”声、衣袂破风声。 • 镜头3 (6-9秒)：空中对撼，火花迸射 • 画面：暗鸦巨剑回撩，与青霜下刺的长剑精准对撞！“铛——！”巨剑的磅礴力量与长剑的灵巧寒气激烈对抗，爆发出耀眼的蓝白色火花与一圈震荡波，将周围雨水全部震开。暗鸦凭借力量优势向下压制，青霜则施展轻功，足尖在巨剑上一点，借力向后空翻，化解千斤重压。 • 运镜：环绕运镜（Bullet Time）。镜头以两人武器碰撞点为中心，进行360度快速旋转，最后定格在火花最璀璨、两人力量抗衡的瞬间特写。 • 对话/音效：青霜（清冷坚定）：“邪不胜正！” • 音效：巨大的金属撞击轰鸣、力量对抗的嗡嗡声。 • 镜头4 (9-12秒)：青影连绵，黑壁固守 • 画面：落地瞬间，青霜率先发动攻势。她身形化为一道青色残影，手中长剑疾刺，瞬间化为数道凌厉的青色剑光，从不同角度刺向暗鸦，剑尖寒气在空中留下道道霜痕。暗鸦低吼一声，将沉重的巨剑舞得密不透风，形成一面紫黑色的剑气屏障。密集的“叮当”声中，青色剑光尽数被挡下，但强大的冲击力仍逼得暗鸦“蹬蹬蹬”后退三步，每一步都将脚下的石砖踩得粉碎。 • 运镜：一镜到底的手持跟拍（Shaky Cam）。镜头紧贴青霜的进攻轨迹移动，伴随每一次刺击产生轻微抖动，随后迅速摇到暗鸦的防守和后退，代入感极强。 • 音效：剑尖撞击屏障的密集清脆声响、石砖碎裂声、沉重的脚步声与喘息。 • 镜头5 (12-15秒)：终极碰撞，气吞寰宇 • 画面：暗鸦暴怒，将全身紫气注入巨剑，猛地插入地面！轰隆！一道粗大的紫黑色光柱冲天而起，搅动天上乌云。青霜毫无惧色，将全部寒气灌注剑身，人剑合一，化为一道巨大、纯粹的青色流光，如彗星般从天而降，直刺光柱中心。两者轰然对撞！时间仿佛静止，随即爆发吞没一切的刺眼白光与环形气浪，将整个庭院的雨水、瓦砾、枯叶全部向外排空。 • 运镜：特写急速拉升。先是暗鸦阴冷双眼和青霜坚毅眼眸的快速对切特写，随后镜头如火箭般急速向后上方拉升（Crane Up），变成俯瞰远景，展现爆炸白光膨胀、气浪席卷古寺废墟的震撼全景。画面在白光最盛处定格。 • 对话/音效：（碰撞前）暗鸦的怒吼与青霜的清吒交织。 • 音效：能量汇聚的嗡鸣、震撼天地的爆炸声、随后一切声音收束，只余雨声渐弱的回响。
